name: Scroll Progress Magazine
description: Long-form magazine article layout with a fixed top reading progress bar and live percent-read badge that fill as the page scrolls, with inline captioned figures.
contents: Fixed top bar with gradient progress fill, label and percent badge
Article header with title and meta items
Body of paragraphs and captioned figures with credit links
behavior: Progress bar scales horizontally with page scroll position
Figure images zoom slightly on hover
editableByProps: Title, label, meta items, paragraphs, figures, captions and credits
Progress bar height, gradient, content width and all colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the border and badge zinc tones of the top bar
needsCodeEdit.where: fixed top-0 left-0 w-full z-50 bar container

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the glow under the progress bar
needsCodeEdit.where: shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(20,184,166,0.3)] class on the progress fill

fixed: Progress bar is fixed to the top of the viewport and tracks the whole page scroll height
Component renders nothing until mounted on the client
